accessibility.statement_intro: TAHAI Press is designed around readable type, keyboard access, resilient layouts, and direct alternatives when embedded documents are not supported by a reader's browser or assistive technology.
accessibility.feedback_note: When reporting a barrier, include the page address, the task you were trying to complete, and the browser or assistive technology involved when possible. Replace this sample address before launch.
